definitions.explanation: An object used to hold or store things, such as bottles, boxes, or jars.

examples.japanese: {食品|しょくひん}は{清潔|せいけつ}な{容器|ようき}に{保存|ほぞん}してください。
examples.english: Please store food in a clean container.

examples.japanese: この{容器|ようき}は{電子|でんし}レンジで{使|つか}えます。
examples.english: This container can be used in the microwave.

examples.japanese: {密閉|みっぺい}{容器|ようき}に{入|い}れて{保管|ほかん}する。

notes:
USAGE: {容器|ようき} is a general term for containers of all types. It's commonly used in contexts involving food storage, chemicals, or packaging.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{密閉|みっぺい}{容器|ようき} (airtight container)
・{保存|ほぞん}{容器|ようき} (storage container)
・プラスチック{容器|ようき} (plastic container)
・{容器|ようき}に{入|い}れる (to put in a container)

NOTE: Do not confuse with {陽気|ようき} (cheerful), which has the same reading.
